newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Pottawattamie County, Iowa.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Pottawattamie County, Iowa.

text.p: General Obligation Capital Loan Notes, Series 1996A

The County of Pottawattamie, Iowa (the receive sealed bids for its General Obligation Capital Loan Notes, Series 1996A in the principal amount of $9,800,000, to be dated December 1, 1996 (the Series 1996A Notes''), on an all or none basis at the Pottawattamie Courthouse, Council Bluffs, Iowa, until 1:00 P.M., C.S.T.,
at which time the bids will be publicly opened and read. Award will be made or all bids rejected at a meeting of the County on that date.
The County intends to designate the Series 1996A Notes as qualified tax-exempt obligations
issuer exception provided by Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.

The County has authorized the printing and distribution of a near final''Official Statement dated October 31, 1996, as required by Rule 15c2-12 of the Securities and Exchange Commission containing pertinent information relative to the Series 1996A Notes and the County and setting forth the Official Terms of Offering under which bids for the Series 1996A Notes will be received and considered. The Official Terms of Offering are incorporated by reference as a part of this Notice and made a part thereof. Copies of such Official Statement and the Official Bid Form may be obtained from Ms. Marilyn Jo Drake, Pottawattamie County Auditor,

Pottawattamie Courthouse, 227 South Sixth Street, Council Bluffs, Iowa; Telephone (712) 328-5700, or from the Public Finance Consultants to the County, Speer Financial, Inc., 55 East Monroe Street, Suite 3435, Chicago, Illinois 60603 (telephone:(312) 346-3700) or 531 Commercial Street, Suite 500, Waterloo, Iowa 50701 (telephone:(319) 291-2077). The Series 1996A Notes are offered subject to the receipt of the legal opinion of Ahlers, Cooney, Dorweiler, Haynie, Smith & Allbee, P.C., Des Moines, Iowa, Bond Counsel, as described in the Official Statement.
